 As an AI Engineer, you will serve as one of our "Tiger Team" engineers: a highly versatile, full\-stack application specialist who designs, builds, and deploys high\-impact AI applications from end to end.  AI Application Design \& Rapid Execution

 Evaluation \& Quality Assurance

* Framework Stress\-Testing: Act as power\-user of our internal AI Development Framework, enabling its capabilities in real\-world scenarios and providing direct feedback to the core architecture team.


**Experience**
 Qualifications \& Skills
   

  

* Industry Tenure: 5\+ years of professional full\-stack software development experience.
* AI Engineering Specialization: Proven track record of designing and deploying production\-grade LLM applications, with a heavy emphasis on multi\-agent architectures.
* The "Tiger Team" Mindset: Experience thriving in fast\-paced, high\-agility environments where requirements evolve rapidly and execution speed is critical.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Orchestration Mastery: Deep, production\-level expertise with LangGraph for building stateful, multi\-agent workflows, alongside standard libraries.
* AI Tooling \& Full\-Stack Stack: Hands\-on mastery of Claude Code for accelerated development, combined with robust backend skills (Python, Node.js) and modern frontend frameworks (React/Next.js).
* AI Evaluation \& MLOps: Strong understanding of LLM evaluation methodologies, dataset curation for testing, and semantic logging/tracing tools (e.g., LangSmith).
* Data Layer: Proficient with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus), relational databases, and integrating unstructured data pipelines.
* Prompt Engineering: Excellent at prompt engineering best practices and with good linguistic intuition for LLM best performance.


 Soft Skills \& Leadership
   

  

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Self\-driven and eager to mentor and share knowledge.
* strong product sense; the ability to balance complex AI logic with intuitive user experiences and immediate business value.
* A self\-starter who can own an application from a blank text document to a live production URL with minimal supervision.
